parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description:
The offset of the position where the system starts the playback. This parameter takes effect only if the input source is a video file. Unit: milliseconds.

A value greater than 0 indicates an offset from the first frame.

parameters.name: ProgramId
parameters.description: The ID of the episode list. If the episode list was created by calling the [AddPlaylistItems](~~2848078~~) operation, check the value of the response parameter ProgramId to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: ResumeMode
parameters.description:
The method to resume the playback of the episode list. Valid values:

*   **Restart**: resumes the playback from the beginning.
*   **Continue**: resumes the playback from the position where the previous playback stops. The **StartItemId** parameter is required only if you set **ResumeMode** to **Custom**.
*   **Custom**: resumes the playback from a custom position.

parameters.name: StartItemId
parameters.description:
The ID of the first episode to play. This episode is the first to play in carousel playback.

>  This parameter is required only if you set ResumeMode to Custom.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live start-playlist --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --program-id 445409ec-7eaa-461d-8f29-4bec2eb90000 --resume-mode Custom --start-item-id asdfasdfasdf0000 --offset 10000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live StartPlaylist --region cn-hangzhou --StartItemId asdfasdfasdf0000 --ResumeMode Custom --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ProgramId '445409ec-7eaa-461d-8f29-4bec2eb90000' --Offset 10000
